story.text: In Milsom Street Anne finds Admiral Croft staring at a {PRINT} in a shop window: “I wonder where that boat was built! I would not venture over a horsepond in it.” Walking her home, he brings {ASTONISHING} news. Louisa is to marry not Wentworth but Captain Benwick! They fell in love while she {RECOVERED}, reading {POETRY} together. Wentworth is {FREE}, and Anne’s heart {LEAPS}.
story.caption: In earnest contemplation of some print
